notes: Ablation variant of router-v1: identical questions and labels, tier options rewritten with concrete examples. Upstream, tier wording alone swung accuracy 21 points, so the wording is a variable worth measuring rather than assuming.
state_hint: The state is a short description of the work a step is about to perform, plus any history the caller wants considered.

tier.instructions: Which tier should perform this step?

criteria.economy: Bounded, target already known. Examples: bump a dependency version; fix a typo or a favicon 404; rename a variable; write a test for existing behaviour; update a README; tag and publish a release; run a pipeline and report its output; answer from the text given.
criteria.frontier: Needs exploration first. Examples: design a new service or backend whose interfaces are not decided; debug a failure across several components; migrate a page or module to a new data source; refactor shared code out of duplicate definitions; run an open-ended loop that discovers its own subtasks.

needs_tools.instructions: To finish this step, does the agent have to act outside its own context — edit files, run commands, call an API or look something up — rather than reasoning over text already provided?

sensitive.instructions: Is this step irreversible, destructive, or credential-bearing: publishing a release or artifact, force-pushing or rewriting history, deploying, rotating or touching secrets, moving money, deleting data, or running untrusted code on a primary machine?
